verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. Verification now separates authenticated mappings from unauthenticated body-marker decoys, authenticating only via the migration label, an exact checkpoint pair, or the existing migration-owned author/title contract; focused tests cover both a sole decoy and a decoy beside a valid mapping. Edge detection now rejects numeric-prefix collisions such as expected #2 versus present #20/#21, and the shared predicate is exercised for both verifier and writer behavior. The focused self-test passes. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found in the diff.
